# Karma Design Studio & Classes, Surat

Embroidery Academy & Design Lab in Mota Varachha, Surat, Gujarat (India).
Bilingual website: English (/en) and Gujarati (/gu).

Two things happen here:
1. Training: live-machine embroidery courses (Zardosi, 4-Beads, Sequence,
   Coding/Cording, Chain & Multi, Laser, Tufting) plus emCAD embroidery
   design software. Free demo class is the first step; evening batches run
   till 10:30 pm. No online payment exists on this site.
2. Design services (B2B): embroidery design development, emCAD digitizing,
   sampling, custom patches and production job work for garment businesses.

Key pages:
- https://karmadesignstudio.in/en/courses
- https://karmadesignstudio.in/en/admissions
- https://karmadesignstudio.in/en/admission (application form)
